version-k.reason: Identification and settings leave relevant model background and actual selection rationale unexplained.

version-m.reason: Shared cited background fulfills relevant capability/limitation/comparison functions; methods supplies actual selection. Short leaves are legitimate.

version-r.reason: Actual selection and settings in methods do not replace missing relevant model background.

version-v.reason: BAB II background is fulfilled but actual selection rationale is absent; repair belongs in BAB III and requires author evidence.

guards: Do not require cloud/local contrast, equal paragraph counts, architecture absent from evidence, or generic theory repeated under each model.
No real-model or author facts may be invented.
Do not use one variant as factual evidence for another.
